text: Carpentry involves the construction of objects and structures from wood alongside various other substances. The trade covers abilities ranging from furniture assembly to home erection. Joints form a basic component of this work, supplying the necessary structural strength for each item. Multiple joint styles exist, such as the mortise and tenon, dovetail, and scarf varieties, where every type demands specific tools and methods. Skilled builders secure stability and lasting power through precise joint fabrication. Following joint completion, the piece receives varnish; this coating serves as a protective layer that improves visual appeal while blocking rot and physical harm.
